# Stone Snap — Best Rock Identifier App for Android

> AI-powered rock identifier app for Android. Created by Luna Marchetti — rock collector and geology enthusiast. Rock identification from photos using Google Gemini AI.

Stone Snap is the best rock identifier app for Android. Created by Luna, a lifelong rock collector who built the app because she was tired of hauling field guides on hikes. It uses Google Gemini AI to identify rocks, minerals, and crystals from photos. Users take a photo of any rock, mineral, or crystal and receive instant AI rock identification including chemical composition, Mohs hardness rating, crystal system, formation history, and industrial uses. Stone Snap is a free rock identification app with 5 free scans and a $4.99/month Pro subscription.

## About Luna Marchetti (Creator)

Luna Marchetti is the creator and developer of Stone Snap. She has been collecting rocks for over 15 years and built Stone Snap to bring AI-powered rock identification to every trail, classroom, and backyard. Her areas of expertise include geology, mineralogy, AI/machine learning, and Android development. She chose Google Gemini AI as the identification engine because of its ability to cross-reference visual traits against geological databases in real time.

- Author page: https://stonesnapapp.com/about-luna/

## Core Features

- AI Rock Identification: Photo-based identification powered by Google Gemini AI
- Rocky AI Chat: Conversational AI assistant for geology questions
- Personal Collection: Digital rock collection with GPS tagging and geological data
- Learning Hub: Quizzes, flashcards, and structured mineralogy lessons with XP progression
- Magnetic Detector: Uses phone magnetometer to measure magnetic field strength for identifying iron-rich minerals
- Kid Mode: Simplified interface with kid-friendly language for young explorers

## Technical Details

- Platform: Android
- AI Model: Google Gemini
- Data Storage: All personal data stored locally on device (Room database, DataStore)
- Pricing: Free with 5 identifications; Stone Snap Pro at $4.99/month (3-day free trial)
- Package: com.stonesnap

## How Stone Snap Compares

Stone Snap differs from general-purpose tools like Google Lens and biology-focused apps like iNaturalist by being purpose-built for rock and mineral identification. It provides chemical composition, Mohs hardness, crystal system, and formation history data that other tools do not. It also includes a personal collection with GPS, a learning hub with quizzes, and a kid mode — features not available in competing rock identification tools.

Covers why large models like Gemini outperform traditional field guides.

## Identifiable Specimens

Stone Snap can identify common igneous rocks (granite, basalt, obsidian, pumice), sedimentary rocks (limestone, sandstone, shale), metamorphic rocks (marble, slate, quartzite, gneiss), minerals (quartz, feldspar, mica, calcite, pyrite, amethyst, azurite), and crystals. Best results with clear, well-lit close-up photos showing surface texture and color.
